name: dbt-spec-driven
description: Spec-driven dbt development workflow. One workflow skill (spec-driven) backed by mandatory standards in AGENTS.md and context-isolated sub-agents for discovery, spec authoring, test authoring, output validation, peer review, and CI interpretation. Includes a CI failure responder for automated bug-fix via dbt Cloud webhooks. Cortex-only.

skills.name: spec-driven
skills.description: The dbt development workflow for this project. Use when: building a feature, fixing a bug, refactoring code, creating or implementing a spec, reviewing code, reviewing a PR, or documenting models.

skills.name: ci-failure-responder
skills.description: Responds to dbt Cloud CI job failures. Creates a Jira bug ticket and triggers the SDD bug-fix workflow in scheduled mode. Use when: a dbt Cloud job fails and you want to auto-fix, or invoke manually with a run URL.

skills.name: spec-review
skills.description: Focused entry point for reviewing current dbt changes through the canonical spec-driven Review phase.

skills.name: spec-debt
skills.description: Report unresolved spec-driven workflow debt: skipped gates, stale issue ledgers, field-feedback follow-ups.

skills.name: verify-this
skills.description: Verify a falsifiable claim with fresh local evidence on non-dbt surfaces.

skills.name: ci-loop
skills.description: Monitor PR checks and iterate on fixable CI failures until green or blocked.

skills.name: quality-audit
skills.description: Strict maintainability and structure audit. For dbt models, run peer-reviewer first.

skills.name: pr-ergonomics
skills.description: Prepare or clean up pull requests after canonical workflow gates are satisfied.

skills.name: work-summary
skills.description: Summarize completed work from git history and spec artifacts.
